item.title: Introduction to Open API Changes in May 2026
item.content:encoded:
Hello, This is the Naver Performance Display Ads Open API team. We would like to inform you of the changes to the Naver Performance Display Ads platform in May 2026. Please refer to the details below.

■ Summary of Changes

[1] New Ad Creative Creation APIs

[2] New Ad Creative Asset (Image/Video) Upload APIs

■ Details

[1] New Ad Creative Creation APIs

Ad creative creation, which was previously available only through the Naver Performance Display Ads site, is now extended to be performed directly via Open APIs. Depending on the ad group's creative type (creativeType) and creative template (creativeTemplateCode), the following creative types are supported:

  • Image Banner Creative Creation API (Smart Channel / Mobile DA)
  • Native Image Creative Creation API (Feed / Banner)
    • Supported templates: NATIVE_SINGLE_IMAGE_V2, NATIVE_SINGLE_IMAGE_PC, FEED_SINGLE_IMAGE, FEED_SINGLE_IMAGE_SQUARE, FEED_SINGLE_IMAGE_2TO3, NATIVE_SINGLE_IMAGE_COMMUNICATION
  • Collection Creative Creation API (Image Collection / Video Collection)
  • Video Creative Creation API (Feed / Banner / In-stream)
    • Supported templates: NATIVE_SINGLE_VIDEO, FEED_SHORTFORM_VIDEO, FEED_SINGLE_VIDEO, INSTREAM_VIDEO

To create Native Image, Collection, or Video creatives, a profile must be registered in advance under Ad Account Management > Profile Management. For required and optional parameters per template, please refer to the Ad Creative Guide documentation.

[2] New Ad Creative Asset (Image/Video) Upload APIs

Dedicated APIs are now provided to pre-upload image and video files for ad creative creation. The ID value returned in the upload response can be used directly as the imageNo, videoNo, or thumbnailImageNo parameter in the creative creation APIs.

  • Image Upload API
  • Video Upload API
    • Only one concurrent call is allowed per ad account.
    • Video files up to 100MB can be uploaded; for larger files, please upload directly via the Naver Performance Display Ads site.
    • callbackUrl registration is supported to receive notifications upon upload/encoding completion or failure.

Effective Date

Wednesday, May 27, 2026

Changes

  • Added Ad Creative Creation APIs
    • New APIs for Image Banner / Native Image / Collection / Video (Feed, Banner, In-stream) creatives
    • Added new Native Image template: NATIVE_SINGLE_IMAGE_COMMUNICATION
  • Added Ad Creative Asset Upload APIs
    • New Image Upload API and Video Upload API (with callback support)

If you have any other questions, please contact us via the Naver Performance Display Ads API inquiry channel.

Thank you.

item.title: Platform Update Notice – April 2025 (effective date of April 24)
item.content:encoded:
Dear users, We would like to announce a new update to the NAVER Performance DA platform in April 2025.

This update includes the following:

■ Changes

[1] Removal of the 'convPartner' field in the Performance API responses

■ Details

[1] Removal of the 'convPartner' field in the Performance API responses

It was previously provided as one of the response fields in both the Past Conversion Data and Real-Time Conversion Data reports. However, due to difficulties in maintaining clear contextual distinction, it will no longer be provided.

Effective Date

Thursday, April 24, 2025

Changes Made

  • Removal of the 'convPartner' field from the responses of Get past conversion data
  • Removal of the 'convPartner' field from the responses of Get real-time conversion data

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at agency_cs@navercorp.com

Thank you!

Best regards, The NAVER Performance DA Open API Team

item.title: Platform Update Notice – March 2025 (effective date of March 14)
item.content:encoded:
Dear users,

We are excited to announce a new update to the NAVER Performance DA platform in March 2025. This update includes the following:

■ Changes

[1] Ad placement reorganization

■ Details

[1] Ad placement reorganization

To optimize ad placements automatically, the ad placements within “Naver” and “Naver Family Media” will be integrated into a unified placement category called “Naver+”.

Effective Date

Friday, March 14, 2025

Changes Made

The ad placements within “NAVER” and “NAVER Family Media” will be integrated into a unified category called “NAVER+” for automatic optimization. As a result, the “NAVER Family Media” placement codes (placementGroupCodes) will no longer be available when creating or modifying ad groups.

ValueDescription
BAND(Deprecated) NAVER's family service > Feed area
F_BANNER(Deprecated) NAVER's family service > Banner area
F_SMARTCHANNEL(Deprecated) NAVER's family service > Smart Channel
  • API > Types > PlacementGroup
  • Ad API > Ad groups > List of ad groups > placementGroupCodes
  • Ad API > Ad groups > Create an ad group > placementGroupCodes
  • Ad API > Ad groups > Update device/placement > placementGroupCodes

  If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at agency_cs@navercorp.com

Thank you!

Best regards, The NAVER Performance DA Open API Team

item.title: Platform Update Notice – September 2024 (effective date of September 26)
item.content:encoded:

■ Details

[1] Location
